title: A finished Flow result does not survive reopening the flow
description:
Run a Flow to completion, close it, open it again: the result pane is EMPTY. The result itself is safe (it was committed to the gallery on completion) but the pane that just showed it comes back blank, so the run reads as lost.

ROOT CAUSE, already traced - do not re-diagnose from scratch. `_lastResults` in js/components/Organisms/MpiBaseFlow/MpiBaseFlow.js is COMPONENT-SCOPED and deliberately not persisted. It survives step navigation (a slide rebuild replays it through `_showResults(_lastResults, { remember: false })`) but not the instance: shell.js's `flow:open` handler destroys the previous MpiBaseFlow and mounts a fresh one, and `el.close()` destroys it outright (MPI-345 - a closed Flow left holding live listeners is what queued a phantom job on the next Ctrl+Enter, so the destroy is correct and must stay). Nothing carries the result across that boundary.

THE ASYMMETRY IS THE BUG. Flow INPUTS already survive - they persist through `state.s_flowInputs[flowId]` and are reseeded on mount, which is why reopening a Flow shows the clip you picked. The result does not, so a reopened Flow shows its inputs and an empty frame: it looks like the run never happened.

SHAPE TO DECIDE, not settled: the obvious move is a `state.s_flowResults[flowId]` mirroring the inputs pattern (top-level replace, per the state proxy rule). Two things to think about first. (1) STALENESS - a persisted filePath can outlive the file (project deleted, media cleaned, item removed from the gallery), so the replay needs the same fallback discipline `_mountCompare` already has rather than painting a dead src. (2) SCOPE - is it the last result, or the last N? One is enough to fix the symptom.

SURFACE IT ALREADY AFFECTS: the compare surface and the video player both hang off the same replay path (MPI-585), so whatever restores the result restores those too - including `_preferredResultMode`, the compare/player toggle choice, which is component-scoped for the same reason. `_compareBefore()` reads the LIVE media slots, so a restored comparison needs the inputs to still be seeded; they are, via s_flowInputs.

NOT a regression from MPI-585 - it predates the compare surface and the video player alike, and was found while closing that card. Sits under the MPI-560 Flow track umbrella but is not one of its named members; it is a Flow UI/state bug, not authoring shape.

Read first: .claude/rules/state.md (the proxy + top-level replace rule), docs/playbooks/add-flow/04-overlay-and-shell.md (the result pane contract), and the `_lastResults` / `_showResults` / `_teardownResultSurfaces` block in MpiBaseFlow.js.
